GAP: no receipt scenario settles cancellation yet. The runner now drives it: scripts/drivers/omp.py child_cancel emits runtime-child-cancel-omp, dispatched from verify-portable.py drive() for this host, driving a bounded --mode rpc session that prompts one child, confirms it in flight through get_subagents, cancels it through cancel_subagent, and reduces the child's terminal subagent_lifecycle into a typed cancelled settlement (the missing-child, unaccepted-cancel and dropped-terminal-frame paths are recorded as bounded negatives instead). evidence_ledger.claim: OMP runtime plane observed live: a bounded omp --mode rpc v2 session negotiated protocol v2, spawned and joined one real model-backed `task` child, and reduced it to a typed settlement on runtime-child-spawn-omp. Only agent.spawn and agent.join claim verified, each pinning that observed_live scenario; the other rows are static-only (pinned to the scenario that exists where one does, otherwise carrying no scenario pin) or, for schedule, unverified. The package plane is an offline lifecycle fixture only, while the native installed-package load is proven by scripts/prove-omp-native-package.py against the real binary; this profile deliberately underclaims what the reducer currently derives, so it claims packaged, not verified.
